road.name: Forest Road 2060 (Clear Creek Road)
road.status: No closure is posted for Road 2060 on the forest's alert list (checked Nov 18, 2026). The one Mountain Loop Highway winter gate listed, Bedal Campground to Barlow Pass, lies well south of the Clear Creek turnoff.
road.driveNote: Head south out of Darrington on the Mountain Loop Highway. Roughly 3.3 mi past the ranger station, Road 2060 branches off on the right, across the highway from Clear Creek Campground. It is gravel from there on; where it splits, stay on the main right-hand branch, drive past the Eightmile trailhead, and carry on to where the drivable road gives out. It gets rougher beyond the trailhead, so a higher car helps.
